ادلهموا (form IVq)
# اِدْلَهَمُّوا (idlahammū) /id.la.ham.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
# اِدْلَهِمُّوا (idlahimmū) /id.la.him.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِدْلَهَمَّ (idlahamma)
